declarations.opening: <button type="button" className="btn-secondary shrink-0" disabled={!canRead || owned?.status === "loading"} onClick={() => void read()}>
declarations.sourceText: <button type="button" className="btn-secondary shrink-0" disabled={!canRead || owned?.status === "loading"} onClick={() => void read()}>{owned?.status === "loading" ? "Finding workflows…" : "Find workflows"}</button>

declarations.opening: <select aria-label="Repository workflow" value={listed ? workflowPath : ""} className="w-full rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-black/20 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-200" onChange={event => { if (data.files.some(file => file.path === event.target.value)) onSelect(event.target.value); }}>
declarations.sourceText: <select aria-label="Repository workflow" value={listed ? workflowPath : ""} className="w-full rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-black/20 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-200" onChange={event => { if (data.files.some(file => file.path === event.target.value)) onSelect(event.target.value); }}><option value="">Choose a workflow file</option>{data.files.map(file => <option key={file.path} value={file.path}>{file.name}</option>)}</select>

declarations.opening: <button type="button" className="btn-secondary shrink-0" disabled={!canRead || loading || Boolean(manualIssue)} onClick={() => void read()}>
declarations.sourceText: <button type="button" className="btn-secondary shrink-0" disabled={!canRead || loading || Boolean(manualIssue)} onClick={() => void read()}>{loading ? "Reading fields…" : "Read workflow fields"}</button>
<button type="button" onClick={defaults} className="text-xs text-zinc-300 underline">Apply missing defaults</button>

declarations.opening: <select aria-label={field.name} value={selected} className={inputClass} onChange={event => change(field.name, event.target.value)}>
declarations.sourceText: <select aria-label={field.name} value={selected} className={inputClass} onChange={event => change(field.name, event.target.value)}><option value="">Not specified</option>{(field.type === "boolean" ? ["true", "false"] : field.options ?? []).map(option => <option key={option} value={option}>{option}</option>)}</select>

declarations.opening: <input aria-label={field.name} type={field.type === "number" && (selected === "" || validNumber(selected)) ? "number" : "text"} step={field.type === "number" ? "any" : undefined} className={inputClass} value={selected} onChange={event => change(field.name, event.target.value)} />
declarations.sourceText: <input aria-label={field.name} type={field.type === "number" && (selected === "" || validNumber(selected)) ? "number" : "text"} step={field.type === "number" ? "any" : undefined} className={inputClass} value={selected} onChange={event => change(field.name, event.target.value)} />

declarations.opening: <button type="button" className="underline" aria-label={`Remove undeclared input ${name}`} onClick={() => change(name, "")}>
declarations.sourceText: <button type="button" className="underline" aria-label={`Remove undeclared input ${name}`} onClick={() => change(name, "")}>Remove</button>

declarations.opening: <button type="button" disabled={state.invalidJson} onClick={() => edit([...state.rows, { name: "", value: "" }])} className="btn-secondary shrink-0">
declarations.sourceText: <button type="button" disabled={state.invalidJson} onClick={() => edit([...state.rows, { name: "", value: "" }])} className="btn-secondary shrink-0">Add input</button>

declarations.opening: <input aria-label={`Input name ${index + 1}`} className={inputClass} value={row.name} onChange={event => edit(state.rows.map((item, i) => i === index ? { ...item, name: event.target.value } : item))} />
declarations.sourceText: <input aria-label={`Input name ${index + 1}`} className={inputClass} value={row.name} onChange={event => edit(state.rows.map((item, i) => i === index ? { ...item, name: event.target.value } : item))} />

declarations.opening: <input aria-label={`Input value ${index + 1}`} className={inputClass} value={row.value} onChange={event => edit(state.rows.map((item, i) => i === index ? { ...item, value: event.target.value } : item))} />

declarations.opening: <button type="button" aria-label={`Remove input ${index + 1}`} className="btn-secondary" onClick={() => edit(state.rows.filter((_, i) => i !== index))}>
declarations.sourceText: <button type="button" aria-label={`Remove input ${index + 1}`} className="btn-secondary" onClick={() => edit(state.rows.filter((_, i) => i !== index))}>Remove</button>

declarations.sourceText: <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void read("connection")}>Read Airflow connection</button>

declarations.opening: <input aria-label="Batch DAG" className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-black/20 px-3 py-2" value={dagId} disabled={busy} onChange={event => { setDagId(event.target.value); setSelection(""); }} />
declarations.sourceText: <input aria-label="Batch DAG" className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-black/20 px-3 py-2" value={dagId} disabled={busy} onChange={event => { setDagId(event.target.value); setSelection(""); }} />

declarations.opening: <button type="button" className="btn-secondary self-end" disabled={busy || !active || !dagId.trim()} onClick={() => void read("runs")}>
declarations.sourceText: <button type="button" className="btn-secondary self-end" disabled={busy || !active || !dagId.trim()} onClick={() => void read("runs")}>Find batch runs</button>

declarations.opening: <select aria-label="Exact batch run" className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-black/20 px-3 py-2 text-xs" value={selection} disabled={busy} onChange={event => setSelection(event.target.value)}>
declarations.sourceText: <select aria-label="Exact batch run" className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-black/20 px-3 py-2 text-xs" value={selection} disabled={busy} onChange={event => setSelection(event.target.value)}><option value="">Choose a specific run</option>{runs.map(run => <option key={run.dagRunId} value={run.dagRunId}>{run.dagRunId} · {run.state}</option>)}</select>

declarations.opening: <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" disabled={busy || !selected || duplicate || wrongConnection || (value?.runs.length ?? 0) >= 25} onClick={useBatch}>
declarations.sourceText: <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" disabled={busy || !selected || duplicate || wrongConnection || (value?.runs.length ?? 0) >= 25} onClick={useBatch}>Use selected batch</button>

declarations.opening: <button type="button" aria-label={`Remove batch ${run.dagId} ${run.dagRunId}`} onClick={() => { const runs = value.runs.filter(item => item.dagId !== run.dagId || item.dagRunId !== run.dagRunId); onChange(runs.length ? { ...value, runs } : undefined); }}>
declarations.sourceText: <button type="button" aria-label={`Remove batch ${run.dagId} ${run.dagRunId}`} onClick={() => { const runs = value.runs.filter(item => item.dagId !== run.dagId || item.dagRunId !== run.dagRunId); onChange(runs.length ? { ...value, runs } : undefined); }}>Remove</button>
